lines.trans: This is the finale, and may the strongest win!
Stop, what is going on over there?
Quiet, guys, I will handle this myself right now.
Vitya, what are you doing right here?
According to the contract I only have to appear on camera.
So here I am honestly standing and being filmed.
But I am not going to cook today.
According to what contract, do you hear me?
Quickly cook any dish right here!
And then go wherever you please!
Guess which finger is in my pocket?
Dima, let's just have no scandals today.

The chef prepared a delicious dish.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

examples.text: Договор? Отдать? Сейчас! Костик, ломай его!
examples.trans: The contract? Hand it over? Right now! Kostik, break him!

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
When there is no money in your pocket.
He put the keys in his pocket.

examples.text: Когда нет в кармане денег. Привяжи ты к швабре веник!
examples.trans: When there is no money in your pocket. Tie a broom to a mop!

meanings.note: В любой момент = at any moment.

examples.text: Любая обезьяна эти выборы выиграет! Ты что, хуже обезьяны?
examples.trans: Any monkey will win this election! What, are you worse than a monkey?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

meanings.en: to win, to be victorious, to defeat
meanings.note: 1st person singular future sets use одержу победу

examples.text: Нет, я хочу победить! Юля, что дальше?
examples.trans: No, I want to win! Yulia, what's next?

meanings.en: to happen, take place, go on
meanings.note: Что происходит? = What is going on?

examples.trans: What is going on? I don't understand.

examples.text: Мы не знаем, что с нашей дочерью происходит!
examples.trans: We don't know what is happening with our daughter!

meanings.note: + 3rd person verb: 'пусть строят' = let them build

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

разобраться.gloss: to sort out, to figure out

meanings.en: to sort out, to settle, to deal with
meanings.note: мы сами разберёмся = we'll sort it out ourselves

examples.text: Аникеев, иди к себе, а мы разберёмся.
examples.trans: Anikeev, go to your room, and we'll sort this out.

examples.text: Ну да, это понятно. Потом разберёмся.
examples.trans: Well yes, that's understandable. We'll sort it out later.

meanings.note: informal: a group of young men; ребята! = guys!

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

examples.text: Тогда ребята с тобой поработают. До свидания, Аркадий Борисович.
examples.trans: Then the boys will have a little word with you. Goodbye, Arkady Borisovich.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

examples.text: Это финал, и пусть победит сильнейший!
examples.trans: This is the finale, and may the strongest win!

examples.text: Это сильнейший шторм за последние годы.
examples.trans: This is the strongest storm in recent years.
A scandal began in the restaurant dining room.
There is no need to make a scene.

examples.text: Если шеф увидит нож, будет скандал!
examples.trans: If the chef sees the knife, there will be a scandal!

examples.text: Как странно, я ничего об этом не слышал.
examples.trans: How strange, I've heard nothing about it.

сниматься.gloss: to be filmed, act; to come off

meanings.en: to be filmed, to act (in a film, ad)

examples.text: Дима, это тебе не в рекламе сниматься!
examples.trans: Dima, this isn't like acting in a commercial!

examples.text: Кажется, оно застряло и совсем не снимается с пальца!

Stop, you cannot go any further!
Stop, that's a wrap! Good job, Samson!

meanings.note: с другой стороны = on the other hand

examples.trans: On the other hand, it's interesting.

examples.text: Бред какой-то. Но, с другой стороны, чем я рискую?
examples.trans: What nonsense. But on the other hand, what have I got to lose?

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

творить.gloss: to do, to perpetrate; to create

meanings.note: colloquial: что вы творите? = what are you doing?

examples.text: Он сам не понимает, что творит.
examples.trans: He doesn't know what he is doing himself.
